goal: Restore legacy GitHub-repo file downloads and deprecate the user-facing Books/DeepRead section.
goal_source: interactive query from human (404 on squidcloud-cluster legacy chunk downloads; deprecate deepread/books UI)
last_actions: 2026-11-24: Systematic debugging. Traced the failing payload to the legacy GitHub branch of squidcloud-cluster. Live CLI SQL showed the failing file dcd032b5 with repo dataMatrix_mczm2tm6_0 and accountId 1; chunks live under GitHub account LamGPT123, while the edge function used global GITHUB_USERNAME/GITHUB_TOKEN (and the DB github_connections username hellosquidcloud) — both returned 404.

Verified with the user-supplied token: api.github.com/user => LamGPT123, and the exact chunk URL returned HTTP 200 with that token (404 anonymously and with hellosquidcloud's token). Root cause confirmed.

Stored dedicated secrets LEGACY_STORAGE_GITHUB_TOKEN / LEGACY_STORAGE_GITHUB_USERNAME via supabase CLI (token not written to repo). Rewrote the legacy download branches in squidcloud-cluster and github-storage to try: dedicated storage account, requesting user's github_connections, indexed legacy accounts, all global accounts, then public access. Deployed both functions via CLI.

Deprecation: removed Books tab + catalog panels from Dashboard, removed standalone DeepReadReader mounts from Dashboard, FileCard, MobileEnhancedUI, ManageFileRequests and SharePage. Instant preview modal still renders DeepReadReader for EPUBs.
Verified no token string in repo, syntax balance; committed de2baf40; Vercel READY.
blockers: No local tsc/deno; Vercel build and Supabase CLI deploy are authoritative.

End-to-end edge function invocation could not be run without the app's PREL token (function returned KZA_PREL_MISSING for an anonymous test); the underlying GitHub fetch is independently verified at HTTP 200.
next: Have the human retry an old file in the app; if a specific repo still 404s, check which GitHub account owns it and add another credential or repo-owner mapping.
